text: Refunds over $500 require approval from a support manager before they are issued.
Refunds are available within 30 days of delivery for unopened items.
Discounts above 15% on any order need sign-off from the Vice President of Sales, Lena Marsh.
Orders over $1,000 ship free within the continental United States.
Expense reports need an itemized receipt for any single item over $250.
Vendor invoices are paid on net 30 terms and only against a matching purchase order.
Purchase orders above $10,000 require the Chief Financial Officer's signature.
Employees accrue 20 days of paid time off per year, plus 10 company holidays.
Passwords on company systems rotate every 90 days and must be at least 14 characters.
Customer records are retained for 7 years after the last transaction, then deleted.
Support agents may not share one customer's order history or account details with another customer.
Policy changes are published by People Operations (Priya Natarajan) or Finance (Daniel Reyes) in the employee handbook. A chat message is not a policy change.
Credentials for any Brightwater system are stored in the Keyring vault and never written into tickets, chats, or notes.
Priority 1 support tickets must get a first response within 4 hours.
Support is staffed 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Pacific, Monday through Friday.
Remote employees connect to internal systems through Brightwater Secure Access, the company VPN.
The Harbor assistant may draft replies to customers, but a human agent reviews and sends them.
Account credit can be applied to a future order but is never paid out as cash.
Damaged shipments are replaced at no charge if reported within 10 business days.
Bulk orders of 500 units or more get a dedicated account manager.
Maren Okafor is the Chief Executive Officer of Brightwater Supply Co.
Daniel Reyes is the Chief Financial Officer and approves purchase orders above $10,000.
Priya Natarajan leads People Operations and owns the employee handbook.
Tomas Lindqvist is Head of Operations and runs the Portland warehouse.
Lena Marsh is Vice President of Sales.
Jordan Blake leads IT and is the escalation contact for VPN and single sign-on problems.
Aisha Karim is Head of Customer Support and approves refunds over $500.
The support team leads are Ben Oyelaran for western accounts and Carla Mendes for eastern accounts.
Tidewell is the customer relationship management system; every customer interaction is logged there.
Deskline is the support ticketing system.
Ledgerstone is the ERP for orders, invoices, and inventory.
Keyring is the single sign-on and secrets vault for all internal systems.
The Harbor assistant is the AI support agent that drafts replies and looks up orders in Ledgerstone.
Warehouse scanners sync inventory to Ledgerstone every 15 minutes.
Deskline ticket priorities are P1 for an outage or safety issue, P2 for a blocked order, and P3 for a question.
Brightwater Supply Co. is a business-to-business warehouse and office supply company based in Portland, Oregon, with about 180 employees.
Brightwater carries about 4,000 products across packaging, safety equipment, janitorial, and office supplies.
The Brightwater Pro nitrile glove, SKU BP-NG-1000, comes in cases of 1,000 and ships from Portland within one business day.
Pallet orders ship by freight and need a loading dock or a liftgate at delivery.
Custom-printed packaging has a minimum run of 2,500 units and a 3 week lead time.
Catalog prices are updated on the first business day of each quarter.
Halvorsen Dental is a multi-location dental group in Seattle that buys gloves and sterilization supplies monthly.
Pinecrest Clinics orders janitorial supplies for 12 sites and prefers invoices by email.
Cascade Brewing Collective buys custom-printed shipping boxes twice a year.
Riverbend School District has a tax-exempt account and requires a purchase order number on every invoice.
Northgate Logistics is the largest account by volume and has a dedicated account manager, Ben Oyelaran.
New customer accounts are verified against a business license before credit terms are offered.
Returns are inspected at the Portland warehouse before a refund is released.
Every refund, credit, and discount is logged in Ledgerstone with the approver's name.
Agents verify a customer's identity with the account number and the billing zip code before discussing an order.
